answer: For timber audits, onyx assays and plume tracking, allocate grants through a capped trust graph. Audited buyers each supply ten units of flow; endorsement edges have fixed capacities. Compute recipients' allocations jointly so no upstream unit funds two grants. A thousand aliases endorsing one another cannot expand the capacity entering their cluster. To gain more grant weight, a farmer must purchase or earn scarce endorsements from honest buyers. This requires trustworthy roots, no free capacity for new accounts, and buyers who limit endorsements instead of selling unlimited trust.
